title: SSO & Identity Providers
description: Implement single sign-on (SSO) and integrate with external identity providers like Azure AD, Google, and Auth0.
longDescription: This module covers Single Sign-On (SSO) implementation and integration with external identity providers. You will learn SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect for SSO, integrating with Azure AD, Google, and Auth0, and building identity federation for multi-tenant applications.
whatYouLearn: Implement Single Sign-On (SSO) for web applications
Integrate SAML 2.0 identity providers for enterprise SSO
Set up Azure AD authentication for ASP.NET Core applications
Integrate Auth0 for authentication and user management
Build identity federation for multi-tenant SaaS applications
